articles.title: Bitcoin's quantum security challenge extends to bridges, custodians and millions of coins
articles.snippet: Quantum computers can’t break Bitcoin network’s security yet, but Leo Fan warns that upgrading it and moving funds could take longer than expected.

articles.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
articles.snippet: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.

articles.title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
articles.snippet: Hong Kong wants to bring crypto brokers, advisers, asset managers and custodians under its existing regulatory framework.

articles.title: Coinbase targets first-half 2027 for its own prediction market contracts
articles.snippet: The move would reduce Coinbase's reliance on a partnership Kalshi, which brought in $200 million in annualized revenue in the third quarter.

articles.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
articles.snippet: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.
